title: BMAD Brutalist Engine
description: A high-performance, statically generated portfolio engine enforcing WCAG AAA monochromatic constraints.

curatorNotes.context: Built to serve as a deeply technical engineering showcase, eliminating runtime bloat in favor of 100% static delivery and native vanilla Web APIs.
curatorNotes.architecture: Utilizes Astro 5.0 SSG with decoupled data structures via Zod-validated Content Collections. Preact was deliberately excluded to maintain a zero-JS framework footprint.
curatorNotes.tradeOffs: Sacrificed native client-side SPA routing in favor of absolute zero-runtime footprint. Global state like theme toggles had to be handled via blocking inline head scripts to prevent FOUC.
curatorNotes.lessonsLearned: Native web standards (like CSS Grid, custom properties, and inline vanilla JS) are more than capable of handling highly interactive requirements without framework overhead.
